data.text: Darj zel misalon par ghour kijiye:

(هُـوَ) ka matlab: 'woh' hai aur yeh kisi shakhs ya cheez ke asli naam ki jagah istemaal hota hai. Darj zeel Quranic jumlon ka mafhoom aap aasaani se samajh sakte hain; inka Tarjuma khud karo. Naye alfaaz ka matlab samne diya gaya hai.

data.text: Aap samajh sakte hain ke (هُوَ) ke shuru mein (وَ: aur) ya (فَ: to) aa ne se (وَهُـوَ) ka matlab 'aur woh' ho ga, aur (فَهُـوَ) ka mafoom 'to woh' hoga.

data.text: (وَهُـوَ) ka ek aur matlab bhi ho sakta hai: 'jabke woh' / 'halankeh woh'. Darj zeel jumlon ka Tarjuma khud dekhiye — aisi jagah dobaara Tarjuma kijiye. Jaise ﴿وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ﴾ jabkeh woh kaafir ho.
Guzishtah sabaq aur is sabaq ki roshni mein aap darj-zail Quranic jumlon ka mafhoom khud samajh sakte hain.

data.text: Darj bala dono jumlon ka matlab par ghaur karein. Inke matlab mein kya fark hai? Yaad rakho agar (هُوَ) ke baad (ال) aane wale lafz se shuru mein ho, toh mafhoom 'Woh hi' hoga. Toh woh ek aik aaam jumla hai lekin agar (هُوَ) ke baad aisalafz ho jo (ال) ke sath shuru mein ho, to takeed ka mafhoom paida ho jaata hai, isliye yahan Tarjuma (Woh hi) ka karo. Isi tarah aane wale Qurani fiqron ke tukdon ka Tarjuma aap khud karo.

data.text: (هُـوَ) ke baad (الْ) wale lafz ke zariye takeed ka yeh andaaz khasosan aisi ayaat mein zyada hai jin mein Allah Ta'ala ki mukhtalif sifat zikr ki jati hain. Agar aap ko Allah ki mashhoor sifat ka maani yaad hai to aap darj zail aayat ka tarjuma bhi ba-asani khud kar sakte hain.

items.arabic: شَاهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا
items.hinglish: gawah ban kar aur khushkhabri dene wala ban kar aur darane wala ban kar aur Allah ki taraf uske hukm se bulane wala ban kar aur roshan charagh ban kar
woh tasdeeq karne wala ban kar haq hai
aur yeh mera shohar boodha hote hue hai
aur yeh aapke Rabb ka raasta seedha hote hue hai

items.arabic: هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا
items.hinglish: woh raat ki ghadiyon mein sajda karne wala aur khada hote hue farmabardar hai
jis ka zikr kiya gaya ho
jis ki madad ki gayi ho
jis se sawal kiya gaya jawabdeh
